newsitem.title: UK: Hicking Pentecost to buy Belding thread.
newsitem.headline: Hicking Pentecost to buy Belding thread.

text.p: UK textiles group Hicking Pentecost Plc said on Thursday it had agreed to buy the thread division of U.S. firm Belding Heminway Co Inc for about 33.3 million stg in cash plus assumed debt of some 0.9 million stg.

Hicking said it would finance the acquisition with bank facilities and a placing and open offer to raise 22 million stg, net of expenses. The company said qualifying shareholders would be able to apply for stock units at 300p per unit, convertible into ordinary shares on a one-for-one basis.
The shareholders would be entitled to apply for up to one stock unit for every three existing ordinary shares held as of December 5, the company said in a statement.
Hicking said Noel Group Inc, which holds a majority of Belding's voting rights, had irrevocably agreed to vote in favour of the transaction.
"The acquisition of Belding Thread will build on our existing operations in the U.S. and enhance our capacity to serve our customers on a global basis," Hicking said.
